entries.note: The vowed specified charity given by another without leave: the reading (no liability) is Abū al-Khaṭṭāb's wajh with Ibn Rajab's preference; al-Qāḍī and Ibn ʿAqīl make him liable. No later work in the cache treats the masʾala; graded on Ibn Rajab's report alone. Residue against the reading; candidate farq al-Qāḍī's (the vow's discharge needs intention, like zakāt).

The sale of the cat: the reading (to be given freely, not sold) is Ibn Rajab's «أصح الروايتين»; the other riwāya permitting the sale is al-madhhab in al-Inṣāf and the jazm of Sharḥ al-Muntahā. Residue against the reading.

evidence.excerpt_ar: الطير. في إحدى الروايتين) . هذا المذهب. صححه في التصحيح، والكافي،
evidence.note: The label closes the Muqniʿ's «ويجوز بيع الهر والفيل وسباع البهائم التي تصلح للصيد … في إحدى الروايتين»: permitting the cat's sale is al-madhhab; al-Mardāwī then gives this qāʿida's «لا يجوز بيع الهر. في أصح الروايتين» under the other riwāya.

evidence.excerpt_ar: بما فيها من عسل ونحل) للجهالة (وكهر) فيصح بيعه لما في الصحيح
evidence.note: The Muntahā with al-Buhūtī's sharḥ states decisively that the cat's sale is valid.
